title: Woman on Diving Board
description: A heavy woman in a purple swimsuit and red swim cap sits on the edge of a high diving board with one hand on the board and the other on the railing. Below her is an indoor pool with glowing blue, green, and purple swirling patterns and a dark silhouette at the center, set in a tiled room with a purple skylight above.
prompt: A heavy woman wearing a purple one-piece swimsuit and red swim cap sits on the edge of a high concrete diving board inside an old tiled pool room, one hand resting on the board and the other on the metal railing, looking down at the water below, the pool water shows glowing blue green and purple swirling vortex patterns with a dark silhouette figure standing at the bright center, purple light comes from a large skylight above, painted in realistic style with visible brush texture.
